title: Sopa de Salchichón (Sausage Soup)
description: A soup made with sausage, ham, and tomato.
steps: Fry a piece of ham
When fried, add peeled and chopped tomato, onion, and garlic
Have a good broth prepared
Add this seasoning with green beans, fava beans, güisquil, carrot, and tender peas, which should be chopped and parboiled in advance
Add a tablespoon of flour fried in butter

description: A soup made with garlic, onion, and tomatoes.
steps: Fry one garlic clove, onion, and four roasted ground tomatoes in one spoonful of oil
Add pepper powder, oregano powder, chopped parsley, and dry cheese powder
Coat a pan with one spoonful of lard
Have tortillas well fried
Dip tortillas in the sauce
Layer tortillas, then cooked brains sliced, then tortillas, alternating layers and ensuring the last layer is tortillas
Pour the remaining sauce on top
Place in the oven or over two fires to cook

title: Sopa de Tartaritas de Arroz (Rice Tartarita Soup)
description: A soup made with rice, egg whites, and rice flour.

ingredients.name: Half a pound of very tender loin

steps: Soak three ounces of rice; when well-soaked wash it and place in the sun for a moment
Grind it, obtaining a fine powder from it
Beat two egg whites and when well-stiff mix in the yolks, rice flour and one tablespoon of grated cheese
Fry in very small cakes in hot lard
Have good broth prepared as the others
Grind half a pound of very tender loin with a little cinnamon, eight Castilian peppercorns, a little saffron and a small piece of cinnamon
When all is well-ground, mix in two eggs, a little salt, the fried mixture and one teaspoon of bread or flour powder
With the tip of a spoon or knife make small meatballs and drop into the broth
When it boils twice add the tartaritas to boil once so they do not fall apart and serve with pepper powder and chopped parsley

title: Sopa de Tortuga (Turtle Soup)
description: A soup made with turtle, tomato, and garlic.
steps: Cook the turtle as for a broth soup and chop the meat
Fry the meat in a soffritto made of tomato, garlic, onion, sweet pepper, powdered pepper, and salt
Prepare lemon juice in fried bread slices with butter, some soda cracker crumbs, and a sauce made from 10 tomatoes and 1 ground and fried onion head dissolved in 1 cup of good broth

description: A soup made with egg yolks, butter or lard, and lard.

ingredients.name: One tablespoon of butter or lard

steps: To four ounces of flour add three egg yolks, a little water with salt and one tablespoon of butter or lard
Knead very well for a quarter hour and let rest for another quarter hour
After this, stretch the dough with a rolling pin and cut out shapes with a mold as desired
Brown in hot lard
In the soup tureen place a layer of tartaritas, one of grated cheese, one of tender chayote and well-cooked carrots, another of tartaritas and another of peas
Pour very well-prepared broth over it and add pepper and very finely chopped parsley

title: Sopa Gren Bichen (Green Broth Soup)
description: A soup made with chicken broth or beef, green beans, and carrot.

ingredients.name: good chicken broth or with beef leg
flour, toasted and fried in butter

steps: Knead a little flour with egg and one tablespoon of butter, let it rest
Have a good chicken broth ready, if desired with beef leg
To this broth add parboiled vegetables: green beans, carrot, peas, sufficient potato, ground tomato, onion, crushed and fried garlic, chopped parsley
If it is too thin, add a little flour toasted and fried in butter
Roll out the dough very thin and cut into small squares
Fill with finely chopped pork meat or chicken with its seasoning fried
Seal the edges very well and just before serving drop them into the broth, letting them boil only once
Add chopped sweet pepper to the broth

title: Sopa Juliana (Julienne Soup)
description: A soup made with green beans, turnips, and carrots.

ingredients.name: Good bone (six pounds if for over twenty people)

steps: Mince very finely: green beans, turnips, carrots and cabbage, adding peas
Lightly fry everything in butter with two bay leaves, two Chiapas peppers, crushed cloves and a thyme branch
Put all this to cook with a broth prepared as follows: cook a plump hen or chicken
If the soup is for more than twenty people, add six pounds of very good bone and a very clean sheep head
Add a handful of garbanzo beans, a bundle of leeks and if desired a celery branch
This broth should boil for six hours and into it drop everything above
Thicken the soup with a little flour fried in butter with chopped parsley
Serve at the third boil

Add raisins, well-peeled almonds, olives, capers and small pieces of chicken or whole squabs that will have been previously made in a stew

title: Tallarines o Macarrones a la Italiana (Italian-Style Noodles or Macaroni)
description: Prepared with milk or water, fat, and meat.
steps: For macaroni, boil as previously described; for noodles, mix one pound of flour with four eggs (white and yolk), half a tablespoon of salt and two teaspoons of milk or water
Knead until the dough is very fine, then roll it out with a rolling pin until very thin
Cut with a special cutter if available, otherwise with a knife, into long forms or as desired
Dust the work surface with flour and place the strips on a cloth also dusted with flour
Prepare a large pot or dish with boiling water and drop the noodles in, making sure they do not stick together
Add a tablespoon of salt to the water, let boil for a quarter hour then remove so they do not retain a flour taste
Drop them in cold water
Prepare the sauce: clean a fat hen and cut it into very small pieces
Fry in lard and butter with two pounds of soft and fatty meat
When it has taken a golden color (without burning), add chopped onion and, if desired, finely chopped green chile
Have ready peeled and chopped ripe tomato; to improve the taste of the sauce, strain it to remove all seeds
Fry this together with the meat for a quarter hour
Add two cups of water with powdered pepper very well seasoned with salt
Let boil for two or three hours and if it becomes too thick add a little water so it has a consistency that is neither thin nor thick
Remove all the meat and in a platter layer sauce, noodles, Parmesan cheese powder and so on until finished, making sure the last layer is cheese
Serve with the sauce as hot as possible; if desired, bake for a quarter hour in the oven

title: Tamales Colorados (Red Tamales)
description: Prepared with rice, lard, and sesame.

ingredients.name: a small piece of fine achiote
half an eighth of Castilian pepper

steps: Soak 2 pounds of rice overnight
The next day let it half dry and grind it very fine
Put it in a pan or dish with 1 liter of water and 1 ounce of salt
The day before, extinguish half an eighth of saffron with hot water and add it to the well-broken dough
Put on the fire with 1 pound of lard, stirring continuously so it does not become lumpy
After half an hour of boiling on medium heat, lower and let cool
Toast 2 ounces of pepitoria and 2 ounces of sesame until golden but not burnt
Grind with 2 cooked guaque chiles, a small piece of fine achiote, half an eighth of Castilian pepper and half an eighth of clove
Grind 6 cold soaked French beans
Dissolve this with a little water and fry in 2 ounces of lard
Add the pieces of turkey or pork with a small teaspoon of salt
Let the sauce and meat boil for one hour
Remove from fire and let cool
Prepare the leaves well cleaned, remove a piece from the bottom, put the leaf upside down with the small piece right side up
Put a spoonful of white dough, make a hole in the middle with the same spoon or skimmer
Put the meat with half a spoonful of dough, trying not to stain the tamal
Place to cook in a clay or pewter pot with cleaned leaf sticks or folders on the bottom
Arrange the tamales on top, leaving a hollow in the middle where a small jug containing 3 liters of water is placed
The tamales should boil for 3 hours on medium heat
If the water runs out during this time, add another liter and a half

title: Tamales con Carne Picada (Tamales with Minced Meat)
description: Prepared with rice or corn or lime, lard, and tomatoes.

ingredients.name: rice or two pounds corn kernels (salpor) cooked with lime
half liter saffron water infused the night before
one and a half pounds lard
three pounds raw pork meat, minced

steps: Soak the rice; the next day wash it and while still half-damp, grind it very fine.
If using corn kernels, cook two pounds with lime, wash, grind while dry, and sieve as before.
Dissolve the masa with one liter of water, one ounce salt, and half liter of saffron water that was infused the night before.
Add one and a half pounds lard.
After boiling for half an hour over moderate heat, remove and let cool.
Grind ten cooked tomatoes with two guaque chiles, a small piece of achiote, some Castilian peppercorns, and a small piece of cinnamon.
Fry this in two ounces of lard.
Add three pounds of minced raw pork meat to the seasoned sauce and let it boil for half an hour.

When everything is cool, place one tablespoon of white masa in the center of a corn husk, then one tablespoon of meat with sauce, an olive, about four capers, and if desired, a slice of hard-boiled egg.
Wrap and cook as before.

Mix with the vegetables and add pieces of well-parboiled dried beef.

title: Tamales Mexicanos (Mexican Tamales)
description: Prepared with corn, lard, and chile.

ingredients.name: six dried chile peppers (chiles de pasa), seeded and soaked

steps: Cook two pounds of corn kernels as before and grind the masa well.
Season with salt and add one glass of cold water and one pound of melted lard.
Knead for half an hour, beating it very hard.
Add another half pound of lard and knead for another quarter hour.
If too thick, add a little more water until the masa is not hard but can be wrapped.
Grind six seeded and soaked dried chile peppers with four roasted tomatoes.
Fry this in two ounces of lard and season with salt.
Add raw chicken pieces to this sauce and let them boil for half an hour, then remove from heat and let cool.
Wash large corn husks with hot water, wring them out, and shake until all water is removed.
Place a little white masa on the corn husk, in the middle put a piece of chicken with its sauce, an olive, two capers, half an almond, and two raisins.
Cover with another small amount of white masa, wrap, and tie on both sides like small cambray tamales, cutting the tip of the corn husk with scissors.
Cook in steam; they will take about one hour over moderate heat, adding a little water, and when it is consumed add more, ensuring the pot has a good base so they do not burn.

title: Tamales Negros de Primera (Black Tamales, First Version)
description: Prepared with rice, lard, and almonds.

ingredients.name: 2 roasted dried chiles or 2 guaque chiles
soaked and split fibers for tying

steps: If using salpor, cook with lime water, wash, grind, and sieve, everything very clean
If using rice, soak the night before
The next day wash very well and dissolve with 1 liter of boiled milk and 1 ounce of salt
The night before, extinguish half an eighth of saffron with half a liter of boiling water
Add to the dough 1 pound of lard
Put on fire without stopping stirring so it does not stick
Add 6 ounces of peeled almonds ground dry, not very fine, and 1 pound of white sugar
If too thick, add more milk
For the sauce, toast 4 ounces of pepitoria, 4 ounces of sesame, 15 cents of the best egg bread
When the bread is well toasted, grind dry as fine as possible

Then grind the pepitoria with one eighth clove, one eighth Castilian pepper, a quarter canela, the well-burnt peel of a plantain, 2 dried chiles roasted in lard; if unavailable, grind 2 guaque chiles and 2 ounces of raisins
Dissolve this with a little water
Put a pan on the fire with 2 ounces of lard and fry the bread powder
Then add the sauce and 2 more glasses of water, the pieces of turkey and pork (both kinds are used), 1 small teaspoon of salt and half a pound of sugar
Let boil until the water is consumed
Remove and let cool
Put a large spoonful on the leaves, in the middle the pepián without staining the tamal
Put a prune, a raisin and half an almond
Wrap and cook as the previous ones, tying them with soaked fibers split in four
The way the tamal is wrapped is what gives it its appeal

steps: Cook three pounds of corn dough as for the others
Sift and grind dry
Moisten with one cup of saffron water, salt, sugar to taste, and one pound of melted lard
Beat for half an hour
Have ready one pound of cooked pork meat, chopped
Fry it in one spoonful of lard
Add sugar and salt to taste, pepper powder, cloves, and cinnamon
When well fried, remove from heat and let cool
Have clean, wide, fine wrappers ready
Place one spoonful of dough in each wrapper, in the middle put a teaspoonful of the chopped meat

Have ready clean, white, well-washed wrappers

title: Almíbar (Clarification of Syrup)
description: Prepared with egg white, water, and sugar.
steps: Beat one egg white in half a quartillo of water for every four to five pounds of sugar; two egg whites in one quartillo of water for ten to twelve pounds of sugar, maintaining the same proportion for greater or lesser quantities
Bring the syrup to a boil until it rises three different times, calming the boil with a little cold water added when it rises
Remove from heat, let it rest and skim; add another small amount of water and boil again
Skim again and strain through a sieve or fine cloth over a frame

For purer syrup, as needed for sweetening liqueurs, after the aforementioned operations tilt the pan or vessel containing it, let it rest and decant, or in other words, separate from the sediment with the least possible movement
The whiter and purer the sugar employed, the less work it will take for the syrup to clarify and the better the sweets made with it will turn out

description: Prepared with bread crumbs, egg yolks, and egg whites.

steps: Scrape the meat from four poultry breasts with a knife, removing all skin and sinews

Beat three egg whites with sugar, stirring until it cools, adding a little lemon juice

title: Azúcar Cande de Azahar (Candied Orange Blossom Sugar)
description: Prepared with sugar, orange, and wine.

ingredients.name: half pound of orange blossoms, white, fresh and clean
quarter of a cuartillo of good wine spirit

steps: Make syrup with four pounds of sugar and clarify it as is customary
Let it boil until it reaches the blown stage
Add half a pound of orange blossoms that have been previously prepared, white, fresh and clean
Let it give twelve boils
Strain through a sieve and return the strained liquid to heat to reach the blown stage again
After skimming and removing from heat, add a quarter of a cuartillo of good wine spirit
Pour into a pot, cover it and place in the stove where it will be kept for eight days, maintaining equal heat
After that time, uncover the pot to drain the syrup, leaving the candied sugar stuck to the bottom
Heat the pot and detach any remaining sugar
The orange blossoms used can be dried in the stove with sugar powder and sifted to obtain candied orange blossoms

title: Azúcar Cande de Violetas (Candied Violet Sugar)
description: Prepared with sugar, syrup, and violet flowers.

ingredients.name: 2 ounces (half a pound) of violet flowers, cleaned
Sugar powder, passed through a silk sieve

steps: Boil one pound of clarified syrup until it reaches the pearl or ball point
When it is half-cooled, add half a pound of cleaned violet flowers
Leave the pot for two hours over hot ashes so the flowers release all their moisture
Strain through a sieve and remove the syrup from the flowers
Dust the flowers with powdered sugar that has been passed through a silk sieve, rubbing gently with your hand to dry them
Return to a sieve and place in the oven until the next morning
Sieve again to separate the sugar from the flowers
Boil three pounds of clarified syrup until it reaches the blown point, with the mold prepared
Pour the syrup into the mold when it reaches the said point, garnishing the surface with the flower sugar without making the layer too thick
Support it from above with a fork so the flowers take the sugar well, ensuring it is completely covered
Leave the mold five days in the oven without giving it a very strong temperature
After this time, strain to separate the syrup
When cooled, remove the candied sugar from the mold by turning it over forcefully onto a paper sheet on the table so the sugar falls out
